message: 普通が一番難しい

name: Paqy
message: 「I-It's freezing. Demon Lord, buy us a kotatsu already.」
While I change into my uniform and put away the futon, Paqy clings to a warm kettle and pleads.

name: Synn
message: 「We can manage just fine without luxuries like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know how drinking hot tea on a sweltering midsummer day cools you down? By that same principle, in the dead of winter, you just need to drink cold tap water.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! Way to go, Prez, I just learned something awesome.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna go drink some water, okay? This'll get me right through winter. Tee-hee-hee~」

name: Sally
message: 「Gulp, gulp, gulp.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hngaaah!? I'm freezing solid~, thud~」

name: Sally
message: 「Clink, clink, clank, clink...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally-chan? What should we do?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just leave her out to dry in a sunny spot somewhere. She'll thaw out and bounce back by noon.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Hmm, it seems there's a structural flaw in my theory.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fundamentally wrong!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Good morning, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa, why are you in my house?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the possible scenarios are--」

name: Paqy
message: 「1. This is the Demon Lord's dream.」

name: Paqy
message: 「2. Your longing for Hiss grew so strong you're seeing an illusion.」

name: Paqy
message: 「3. Your parents remarried, making the Demon Lord and Hiss step-siblings.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something along those lines.」

name: Synn
message: 「My mom and dad are totally lovey-dovey, and aren't Misa's parents both alive and well too?」

name: Misa
message: 「4. I got worried about Sakura-kun and came to check on you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine, you know? I sleep with a hot water bottle every night, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「In the morning, I use that water to wash my face and brush my teeth. By morning, it's cooled down to just the right lukewarm temperature.」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't come here to listen to your granny-style life hacks!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Between us, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm happy you're treating me just like before, but it's okay if things change just a little, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey now, the second Hiss showed up like a self-invited wife, things already weren't the same as before, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's a 'self-invited wife'?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a woman who barges right into a guy's house and claims the spot of his legal wife.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not a bride yet!! I told you I just came to check on Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Did nothing happen to you? There was a pretty big earthquake last night, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I had no idea...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's been all over the TV and radio. Fortunately nobody died, but a lot of people got injured.」

name: Synn
message: 「My TV only gets static, and the radio can't pick up anything because of signal interference.」

name: Misa
message: 「I see... Over in the shopping district, goods fell off the shelves, so they're putting everything back in order right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah! Nanaka!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Calm down. Nanaka-san is safe. I just went to see her earlier. None of her family were hurt either.」

name: Synn
message: 「You only went to look?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up! Even if I wanted to help, everything was already cleaned up by the time I got there!」

name: Misa
message: 「So instead, I came out of my way to worry about Sakura-kun's safety. You should be grateful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey! You're supposed to scold me for sounding so haughty.」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't change the fact that you were worried about me.」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, how are your parents, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't worry. The apartment building shook violently too, but neither Father nor Mother has so much as a scratch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you live in an apartment building.」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!?」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Grrrrrrr!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Snuggle! Rub, rub, rub. When Misamisa gets all huffy and puffy, she's so waaarm!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey now, Sally, please don't cling to me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Body temp spikes when she gets mad, huh? Living up to her hysterical reputation.」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's you, Paqy... I wouldn't mind if you clung to me, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly is devoted to Ria-chan alone. I ain't got no interest in a half-baked flat board.」

name: Misa
message: 「Screeeeeeech!」

name: Sally
message: 「Toasty, cozy, ahh~n.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misa. Aren't you kind of forcing yourself to get angry?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's, well... um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, talk to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I might not be able to do anything for you, but I can at least listen.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not true! You've done so much--」

name: Misa
message: 「The song is finished... I want Nanaka to hear it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Leave the rest to me!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, see?! You can do plenty more than just listen!」

name: Sally
message: 「Congrats, Misamisa!」
Misa and I arrived at the old school building.

name: Ria
message: 「I guess this is as far as I can help you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama...」

name: Ria
message: 「I've already called Nanaka-chan to the Student Council room. What comes next is something you have to do on your own, Misa-chan, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you very much, Onee-sama...」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, it's too early to thank me yet. Save that for after everything goes well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, let's get going.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huheh? Where might you be heading? I shall accompany the President as well.」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan, the two of us have a mission as 'Angelic Agents.'」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! Mission #36: 'Uncover the Truth Behind the Mysterious Earthquake That Struck Ryuusei Town!'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fueeh? You mean that weird earthquake last night that only shook this neighborhood?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you ask me, Omake-san's Boss's sumo wrestler was out running midnight beef bowl deliveries. There is no doubt about it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... I feel like you're actually pretty close to the mark.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san, rather than such trivial matters, we ought to unravel the secret of why there are no actual bush warblers inside Prier's bush warbler buns.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly the incarnation of societal evil. We shall vanquish it, 'Angelic Agents'!! Move ooout♪」

name: Ria
message: 「...W-who exactly are we defeating?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai, Lolo-chan? What took you so--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san...」
Nanaka shuts her mouth and tries to leave the Student Council room

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you're in the way standing in front of the door. Move.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Nanaka. Misa is--」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, I'll be the one to tell her!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I can say it...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, please listen to me. You don't even have to look at my face.」

name: Misa
message: 「The song for the Holy Night Festival is finished.」

name: Misa
message: 「I... I wrote these lyrics because I wanted you to hear them.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just once is enough, please listen.」
Nanaka doesn't answer. Because of that, Misa can't sing either.
There's even a chance this will make their relationship worse.
If that happens, the Holy Night Festival will end in failure.
Still, this conversation has no meaning unless Misa is the one to initiate it.
All I can do is give Misa a gentle push forward.
What I can do...?

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... Misa...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Sakura-kun!?」
The moment the idea struck me, I grabbed both of their hands and started running.

name: Synn
message: 「Look. You can sing comfortably here, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」
Under the starry sky, in this crisp, clear air, Misa's singing voice is sure to ring out even more beautifully.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, give it a listen. It really is a wonderful song.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, Misa. Do your best.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes... I'll sing...!」
Misa musters up her courage and begins to sing.
Her desire to make the Holy Night Festival a success together with everyone on the Student Council.
Nanaka simply stared intently at the sight. However--
Before she knew it, she realized those lyrics were directed at her.
Lyrics filled with the wish to have a fun time together with everyone.
Misa's unadorned, honest feelings.
With their clear eyes sparkling, they play on.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ngh... ngh...」
The two hearts that had drifted apart draw steadily closer.
The two bodies that had been apart draw steadily closer.
What kind of feelings had they been harboring until now?
What kind of feelings are they harboring right now?
Confirming those feelings and savoring them--
The moment they finished singing the song, the two of them turned to face each other.

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, I'm sorry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Misa... I'm... s-sorry too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheehee.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tehe, tehehehe!」
Misa and Nanaka wear smiles without a shred of hidden meaning.
It's so simple, yet so difficult.

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa.」
Misa and Nanaka walk toward each other, each reaching out a hand as if on cue to shake--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoopsie, we're missing one person.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're right. How careless of me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you get over here too! Don't just stand around over there forever, let's all three of us shake hands together!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't even do anything, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the only one who thinks that, Synn!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just shut up and hurry over here already!」
Nanaka pulls my hand and places it right over Misa's.
A handshake with all three of us together.
Surpassing the sparkle we had before, the beginning of a brand-new sparkle.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah!」
After joining my hand and Misa's together, Nanaka pulled her own hand back first.

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, that settles it!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nanaka-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'that settles it,' Nanaka? You said the three of us would be together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We are together. You can still feel the warmth of my hands on yours, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's plenty for me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, you two should just start going out already. You're officially a Nanaka Yuugiri-approved couple.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh... whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But, I couldn't...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's dense as a brick, and Misa isn't honest with herself. If I don't step in like this, you two will never become lovers.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa, please...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've been throwing my arm around Synn's shoulders ever since we were little.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And I'll keep doing it from now on, too. So... so, Synn, put your arm around Misa's shoulders...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speak up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You answer too, Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ow-ow-ow! I... I got it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I heard you loud and clear, okay? Now then, I'll leave the rest to you two lovebirds while this old lady makes her exit.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, Misa! Th-Thanks!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, crap!? I forgot to thank Nanaka.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh no, I have to go too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go after Nanaka-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we'll see Nanaka again tomorrow. We can thank her thousands of times then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because the bond between the three of us will keep going forever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa...... can I say it one more time?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「I really am in love with you, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I...... love you too......」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, then this will be our first kiss.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How awful...... did you forget? I already gave it to you the other day......!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's pretty uncool for the Student Council President to have her first kiss stolen, right? So this time, I'm going to steal yours, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes?」

name: Misa
message: 「J-Jeez, Sakura-kun, you really are hopeless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...... mm, mnh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah...... mm, Sakura-kun......」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why are you apologizing? Don't apologize......! I didn't hate it.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I mean.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-Then what is it? What happened between us...... I-I don't regret it at all......」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, that's not it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just feel like from now on, every time I see you, Misa, I'm going to remember that kiss.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「What if I get so distracted by your lips that I can't focus on my duties as president?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot...!」
